post.description: Re-validates the license at approval time and makes the card eligible for the next POST /admin/songs/publish run.

post.summary: Build unsigned add_cards XDR batches for all APPROVED songs
post.description: Returns one unsigned Soroban transaction XDR per batch of ≤20 cards. The admin wallet (LF-219) must sign and submit each XDR, then call POST /admin/songs/:id/mark-published with the returned on-chain card_id. The API holds no secret key (LF-227); it never signs or submits.

201.description: Unsigned XDR batch(es) ready for the admin wallet to sign

post.summary: Record the on-chain card_id for a confirmed card — APPROVED → ON_CHAIN
post.description: Call this for each song after the admin wallet has signed and submitted the XDR from POST /admin/songs/publish and the transaction is confirmed. Stores the contract-returned card_id and flips the song to ON_CHAIN, satisfying the acceptance criterion: every on-chain card has a database record with its license and reviewer.

201.description: Song marked as ON_CHAIN with card_id recorded

400.description: Song is not in APPROVED status

info.title: Songify LyricFlip API
info.description: API documentation for the Songify LyricFlip backend

notifications.description: All notifications addressed to the user

privacyNote.description: Privacy note explaining what data is on-chain and cannot be erased

username.description: Desired username. 3–20 characters, lowercase letters/digits/underscores only.

addresses.description: List of Stellar wallet addresses to look up (max 100 per call).

totalPoints.description: Total points accumulated in the period

bestRoundScore.description: Highest single-round score in the period

flagStatus.description: Anti-cheat moderation status. Null = no flags. 'hidden'/'banned' entries are suppressed on public leaderboards.

total.description: Number of players on the board

totalPoints.description: Total points accumulated across all rounds

totalAnswers.description: Total answers submitted in the round

won.description: Whether the player won the round

checkedAt.description: When the reconciliation job last ran.

dbEscrowedTotals.description: Sum of escrowed wager amounts in the database, per asset.

contractBalances.description: Escrow contract token balance read from the chain, per asset.

differences.description: Per-asset difference (contract balance minus DB escrowed total).

matched.description: True when every asset matches within the tolerance.

alert.description: Human-readable summary when a mismatch is detected.

lyrics.description: Lyric snippet. At most 20 words, single line/phrase (content-policy.md).

source.description: Where the lyric text came from, e.g. "Original demo lyrics written for LyricsFlip (CC0)".

license.description: SPDX identifier or LicenseRef-<provider> for licensed data. Allowed values: CC0-1.0, CC-PDDC, LicenseRef-PublicDomain, or any LicenseRef-<provider>.

ready.description: Whether the player has signalled ready

joinedLedger.description: Ledger sequence when this player joined

admin.description: Stellar address of the round admin/owner

playerCount.description: Number of players currently in the round

createdLedger.description: Ledger sequence when the round was created

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the round started; null if not yet started

enabled.description: false to opt out, true to re-enable.

onChainCardId.description: Contract card_id, once the card is on-chain

source.description: Where the lyric text came from

reason.description: Human-readable reason for rejection (shown to submitter and stored in the audit log).

songIds.description: Database UUIDs of the songs in this batch, in wire order.

total.description: Total number of approved songs batched.

batches.description: One entry per add_cards batch (max 20 cards each).

onChainCardId.description: On-chain card_id returned by the add_cards transaction.
